issues.t: Steering suddenly feels heavy or sticky (recall)
issues.sym: The steering suddenly takes much more effort, or feels sticky or notchy, while driving.
issues.why: A spring that holds the steering gear teeth together can let the gears bind, which changes the steering feel without warning. Mazda recalled about 44,000 CX-90s in early 2024. In 2026 federal safety regulators opened an investigation after owners reported the same problem on vehicles that had already had the recall repair.
issues.next: Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and get the free repair if it has not been done. If the problem continues after the repair, report it to the dealer in writing and file a complaint with NHTSA.

issues.t: Plug-in hybrid can shut down while driving (recall)
issues.sym: The engine and electric motor shut off while driving and the SUV loses drive power, usually with warning lights and a message on the dash.
issues.why: A software error lets the inverter run too hot, and the system then shuts itself down to protect it. Mazda recalled about 4,250 early CX-90 plug-in hybrids and updates the engine and powertrain software for free.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Check your VIN for the recall and have the software updated.

issues.t: Loss of drive power from engine software (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights come on and the SUV may lose drive power while moving.
issues.why: Faulty software in the powertrain and engine computers can put the vehicle into a fail-safe mode. Mazda recalled about 31,500 2024 CX-90s (and some 2025 CX-70s) to reprogram them.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Get the free software update at a Mazda dealer. Until then, take any warning light seriously and pull over safely if power drops.

issues.t: Loss of power in EV mode from inverter software (recall)
issues.sym: While driving on electric power, the check engine light comes on and the SUV can lose drive power.
issues.why: The plug-in hybrid inverter, which feeds power to the electric motor, had software that could fault. Mazda recalled about 14,900 plug-in hybrids to install improved software.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free inverter software update.

issues.t: Engine may not restart after auto stop (recall)
issues.sym: After the engine shuts off at a stop light to save fuel (i-stop), it fails to start again when you lift off the brake.
issues.why: A software problem in the powertrain and battery control computers can stop the engine from restarting. Mazda recalled about 38,900 2024 CX-90s built between late 2023 and April 2024.
issues.next: Get the free software update. Until then, you can turn off i-stop with its button each time you drive.

issues.sym: The fuel gauge shows more fuel than is really in the tank, so the SUV can run out of gas and stall without warning.
issues.why: Body control computer software can display the wrong fuel level. Mazda recalled about 105,000 2024-2025 CX-90 and 2025 CX-70 mild hybrids to update it.
issues.next: Get the free software update. Until it is done, track your mileage between fill-ups and do not run the tank low.

issues.t: Defroster, seat belt chime or 360 camera may not work (recall)
issues.sym: When starting the SUV, the windshield defroster, seat belt reminder chime and light, or 360-degree camera may not work. On plug-in hybrids the high-voltage battery cooling may not run properly.
issues.why: The dash electrical supply unit, which powers these systems, has a software problem. Mazda recalled about 80,900 2024-2025 CX-90s and 2025 CX-70s.
issues.next: Get the free reprogramming. A defroster that does not work is a visibility risk in cold or wet weather.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking can brake for no reason (recall)
issues.sym: The SUV suddenly brakes hard on its own when there is nothing in the way.
issues.why: The automatic emergency braking system can wrongly detect an object ahead. Mazda reprograms the vehicle control software under a recall.
issues.next: Get the free update. If it happens, stay calm, check your mirrors and keep control; report each event to the dealer.

issues.t: Steering and suspension bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clunks or rattles from the front end, a vague steering feel, or warning lights from a wheel speed sensor.
issues.why: Some early CX-90s left the factory with loose or missing bolts on the steering shaft, front upper control arms or wheel speed sensor wiring. Mazda inspects and tightens or replaces them under a recall.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have the inspection done soon. Any new front-end clunk should be looked at right away.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture does not show on the screen when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A software error in the camera control module can stop the image from showing. Mazda updates the software for free.
issues.next: Get the free update and use your mirrors and a look over your shoulder when backing up until it is fixed.

issues.t: Pedestrian warning sound may be wrong (recall)
issues.sym: The low-speed warning sound that alerts people walking nearby may not sound right on the plug-in hybrid.
issues.why: The amplifier for the pedestrian warning sound was missing software, so the sound did not meet the federal rule. Mazda updates it for free.
issues.next: Get the free update, and take extra care around pedestrians in parking lots until it is done.

issues.t: Hybrid System Malfunction warning with power loss
issues.sym: A "Hybrid System Malfunction" message with warning lights and chimes, sometimes followed by a sudden loss of power, stalling, or a SUV that will not move until it is restarted.
issues.why: Several software recalls address this, but owners of both 2024 and 2025 plug-in hybrids report it coming back after updates. The exact cause is not always found.
issues.next: Make sure every recall and software update has been done. Keep records of each dealer visit; repeated safety repairs can matter under state lemon laws.

issues.t: Jerky or harsh shifting at low speed
issues.sym: Jerks, lurches or clunks in stop-and-go traffic, a harsh shift from first to second, a delay when pulling away, or a jolt when the plug-in hybrid switches from electric to gas power.
issues.why: The CX-90 uses a wet clutch pack instead of a traditional torque converter in its 8-speed automatic, which Mazda says can make the drivetrain feel less smooth. Software updates have helped some owners but not all.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check for transmission and powertrain software updates. If the dealer can feel the problem, ask that it be written on the repair order.

issues.t: Front brakes squeal at low speed
issues.sym: A high-pitched squeal or screech from the front brakes, often at very low speeds or in cold weather.
issues.why: Owners report brake squeal even on new vehicles. Dealers often treat it as normal pad noise, and there is no single fix.
issues.next: Not usually a safety issue, but have the brakes inspected to rule out worn pads. Different pads or anti-squeal shims sometimes help.

issues.t: Center screen goes black, reboots or CarPlay drops
issues.sym: The center display goes black, the system reboots at startup, voice control will not start, or Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep disconnecting.
issues.why: These are software bugs in the Mazda Connect system. Mazda issued a service bulletin with a software update for 2024-2025 CX-90s built before June 2025.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to install the latest Mazda Connect software; it has to be done by USB at the dealer.

issues.t: Side mirror shakes at highway speed
issues.sym: The outside mirror vibrates at highway speeds, making it hard to see what is behind you.
issues.why: Owners report mirror shake on new 2024 CX-90s, likely from how the mirror housing is mounted.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to inspect the mirror mounting under warranty.

issues.t: Dead 12-volt battery and stuck in Park
issues.sym: The plug-in hybrid will not start because the 12-volt battery has gone flat, and the SUV cannot be shifted out of Park to be pushed or towed.
issues.why: Owners report battery drain on the plug-in hybrid, often alongside hybrid system warnings. With no 12-volt power the electronic shifter cannot leave Park.
issues.next: Keep a jump pack handy and have the battery and charging system tested. Report repeat drains to the dealer so they can look for a software fix.
